description: The panel shows what reflection reports without account access. The VM has four integrations: gh, llm (whose details list anthropic, mode managed, and openai, mode api_key with 3 chat models), notify, and reflection (at https://reflection.int.example.test, whose help is "curl https://reflection.int.example.test/"). Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The modal" is ".integrations-modal". To "open the panel": press Control+k; ".command-palette-input" should be visible; fill it with "integration", click the first ".command-palette-item", and the modal should be visible. To "select" an integration N: click the first ".integrations-tabs button" (the list), then the ".integrations-name-btn" whose text starts with N followed by a space; ".integrations-detail-head strong" should then have exactly the text N. "The refresh button" is the modal's button named "Refresh"; "the Slack test button" is the button named "Test integration (webhook only)"; "the notify button" is the button named "Send test notification". To "close the modal": click the modal's button whose name contains "Close modal". To "start": navigate to /new, wait for the element with data-testid "message-input" to be visible, and open the panel. Perform the steps in order. 1. Start, and select llm. 2. There should be exactly 2 ".integrations-providers-table tbody tr". With all whitespace removed from their text (an eval), the first row's must contain "anthropicexe.devmanaged—" and the second's "openaiapi_key3chat". 3. Select reflection. ".integrations-guide" should contain the text "curl https://reflection.int.example.test/". 4. Click ".integrations-advanced summary": ".integrations-advanced" should contain the text "https://reflection.int.example.test". 5. Select notify. The modal should hold no element with role "alert" (count 0), and the notify button should be enabled.
